item.title: Morgan Creek Entertainment
item.description: With a 30 year history as one of Hollywood's most successful independent film production companies, Morgan Creek is owner to legacy films such as Ace Ventura, Major League, and Young Guns. Learn more about our history, upcoming projects, and how to license clips from our extensive library of films and music scores.
